etymology.historical_story: Wyatt carries several strands of English naming history. A surname dictionary connects it with medieval Wiot and Wiet, often familiar forms associated with Wy or William. Some families instead connect through Wyard. The spelling Wyatt developed from Wyot(t) during the sixteenth century, so a single literal translation cannot explain every bearer. [Surname dictionary](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/wyatt)
